findings.summary: summarize() iterates the one-shot generator from read_rows twice (any() at line 25 consumes rows, then the for loop at line 28 sees only the remainder), so totals and high-severity counts are wrong and the report can falsely say no high-severity events occurred.
No test covers summarize() with the generator-returning read_rows; the new test_read_rows_is_lazy only exercises the reader.
